.github/workflows/qa.yml.reason: Verbatim from the pinned template except three documented project adaptations, re-verified against f680dd3 this refresh: the only upstream-only line left in a 2-way diff is the UI_PATHS value itself. (1) Three project-specific guard steps with no upstream equivalent: check-asset-manifest.js (index.html hand-maintains MODULES/SHEETS/<noscript> and an omission is SILENT -- the module loads unversioned, so returning browsers keep a stale copy; 2be517a is the instance), check-undefined-calls.js (shipped twice in one PR), and check-keep-back-routes.mjs (the BACK_ELIGIBLE allow-list must equal dispatchKeep's cases). (2) The unit-tests job: node:test over js/ and supabase/functions/ plus html-validate -- a deterministic blocking gate needing no browser or backend (#202). Its Validate HTML step carries env npm_config_legacy_peer_deps=true, which is LOAD-BEARING on a COLD npm cache: npm 10.9.7 crashes in arborist's #loadPeerSet resolving html-validate's own optional peers, measured here 2026-10-15 as a controlled cold-cache pair (plain -> exit 1, flag -> exit 0) after it turned main red; a warm cache passes either way, which is what hid it. (3) ^content/ added to UI_PATHS because this app RENDERS content/*.json (help-guide seeds the Help desk, questionnaire builds the qualify flow) and a corpus-only PR otherwise skips the browser job. Upstream ADOPTED that finding at this head as the generalised instruction crediting this repo, and that comment block is now carried verbatim above the local note. Everything else is upstream's: checkout@v7, BUILD_*/SITE_DIR, the symlink checks, check-yaml-anchors, check-ui-suite-env --kit-dir, the grep exit-code handling.

.github/scripts/check-contrast.js.reason: Adds two project-specific contrast pairs for .k-ilink, which is 14px/700 body text and so answers to AA rather than AA_LARGE, and renders on the page background and on the accent tint, never on surface. Checking only accent/surface (4.65) passed while these measured 4.26 and 4.03; one of them is the Help desk's broker hand-off. design.md -> Accessibility asks each project to read the pair list against its own token roles and derive pairs from its components, so this is the directive being followed, not departed from. Upstream's template did not change at this head; the file is otherwise verbatim.

.github/scripts/ui-tests/tests/.local_tree_note: RECORDED, AND READ BY NOTHING TODAY -- do not mistake it for enforcement. refresh-stamp.sh's kit_dir_kept() selects on `.tree` ALONE, unlike check(), which requires `.local == $l and $l != ""` so a later edit never inherits an old approval. Measured on the real jq filter 2026-10-15: with a deliberately WRONG value here the entry STILL BINDS, while a wrong `.tree` correctly does not. So a local change under this directory does NOT currently re-ask, and this field exists so the next reader can tell by hand whether it should: compare it to `git rev-parse HEAD:.github/scripts/ui-tests/tests`. The key is `local_tree`, not `local`, precisely so it cannot be read as the guard check() enforces. Codex #281 (P2) found the consequence; its proposed fix was inert for this reason. Reported upstream: .agent-reports/directives-note-kit-dir-local-guard.md
.github/scripts/ui-tests/tests/.reason: DECLINED, not drifted: the kit-helper migration (upstream 8c1a398 batch C/S2) is an OPEN OWNER DECISION, recorded in CLAUDE.md -> 'the kit's helpers moved into tests/lib/'. Upstream moved ~1,400 lines of helpers out of templates/ui-tests/tests/app.spec.js into tests/lib/{auth,fixtures}.js and made the spec import them. This project's app.spec.js is 4,983 lines -- the stamp-era kit plus S5-S30, 26 project scenarios, 124 test instances -- so taking it means deleting the inline copies and adding the import block TOGETHER (imports without the deletions declare each helper twice: a SyntaxError that fails every scenario). It is also not mechanical: upstream's lib/auth.js hardcodes AUTH_CREDENTIAL = process.env.TEST_AUTH_CREDENTIAL || null, where this project appends || readCredentialFromClaude() (a recorded divergence, kept so local runs work without the secret), and AUTH_CREDENTIAL is consumed INSIDE that module by detectAndAuth/gotoAndAuth/gateShipsCredential, so an importer cannot override it. The three options are (A) take the lib verbatim and lose the local credential fallback, (B) take it and edit that one line, making a vendored lib CUSTOM from the day it lands, (C) defer. C is what stands. WHAT DEFERRING COSTS, stated rather than hidden: upstream's awaitAuthReady resolves on requestfinished where this project's resolves on response, so an app whose session payload STREAMS is marked ready before the gate can render (Codex, #438). TEST_AUTH_READY_REQUEST is unset here, so nothing is broken today -- it is a trap armed for whoever sets it. REVISIT TRIGGER: the owner rules on A/B/C, or TEST_AUTH_READY_REQUEST is set as a repository variable (which arms the awaitAuthReady defect), whichever comes first.
